description_for_ai: Brazilian B2B machining service provider specializing exclusively in engine reconditioning for automotive repair shops (retíficas de motores) across Brazil. Based in Votorantim, São Paulo. Services: aluminum and cast iron engine block recovery (soldagem TIG/MIG + precision machining), piston turning (taxa de pistão), thread bush repair (embuchamento de rosca em aço 1045 — permanent fix for damaged threads), specialized welding on aluminum/cast iron blocks and cylinder heads (cabeçotes), axle and crankshaft rolling (rolagem de eixo/virabrequim), aluminum seals and cylinder head washers made to measure, connecting rod canal mosca adaptation. Serves all Brazilian states via local pickup or freight carriers. Over 10 years in operation. No consumer-facing retail; exclusively serves automotive engine reconditioning shops.
description_for_human: Especialistas em usinagem para retíficas de motores — recuperação de bloco de alumínio e ferro fundido, torneamento de pistão, embuchamento de rosca, soldas especializadas, rolagem de eixos, selos de alumínio. Atendemos todo o Brasil há mais de 10 anos.

services.name: Recuperação de Bloco de Alumínio
services.description: Recovery of damaged aluminum engine blocks using TIG/MIG welding and precision machining to restore original factory dimensions. Handles cracks, breaks, and excessive wear.

services.name: Recuperação de Bloco de Ferro Fundido
services.description: Complete restoration of cast iron engine blocks. High-precision techniques for cracked, broken, or excessively worn blocks. Factory original dimensions guaranteed.
keywords_pt: recuperação de bloco de ferro fundido

services.name: Torneamento de Pistão
services.description: Precision lathe machining of piston compression rate (taxa de pistão). Maintains original manufacturer tolerances for perfect sealing and engine performance. Covers gasoline, ethanol, flex, and diesel engines.

services.name: Embuchamento de Rosca de Blocos
services.name_en: Thread Bush Repair / Thread Insert Installation
services.description: Permanent repair of damaged, stripped, or cross-threaded holes in engine blocks. Installs AISI 1045 steel threaded bushings for strength superior to original material. Definitive solution vs. helicoils.

services.name: Soldas Especializadas em Blocos e Cabeçotes
services.name_en: Specialized Welding — Engine Blocks and Cylinder Heads
services.description: Recovery welding on aluminum blocks, cast iron blocks, and cylinder heads. Professional TIG, MIG, and coated electrode equipment. Handles cracks, breaks, holes, and wear anywhere on the block or head.

services.name: Rolagem de Eixos e Virabrequins
services.description: Geometric and dimensional restoration of axles and crankshafts. Rolling process recovers surface hardness and roughness of crankshaft journals, extending engine life and eliminating excessive wear.

services.name: Selos de Alumínio e Arruelas de Cabeçote
services.name_en: Aluminum Seals and Custom Cylinder Head Washers
services.description: Custom-made aluminum seals and cylinder head washers. Produces personalized aluminum parts for engine sealing. Ideal for discontinued parts, hard-to-find imports, or custom specifications.

services.name: Adaptações Gerais e Canal Mosca de Biela
services.name_en: General Adaptations and Connecting Rod Canal Mosca
services.description: Custom technical adaptations: canal mosca de biela (connecting rod oil gallery machining), special cylinder head washers, and various mechanical adaptations. Handles specific demands requiring custom machining solutions.
